name: 陳明彥
objective: Statics is the fundamental of other application subjects, including mechanisms, mechanical design, and mechatronic systems, etc.. The course introduces the following topics: Force Systems, Equilibrium, Structures, Distributed Forces, Centroids of Volumes and Mass, Momemts of Inertia, Analysis of Structures, Friction, and Virtual Work.
schedule:
Week 1：Course introduction, General principles
Week 2：Force systems
Week 3：Equilibrium
Week 4：Mid-term exam I
Week 5：Plane trusses - Method of Joints
Week 6：Plane trusses - Method of Section
Week 7：Frames and machines
Week 8：Mid-term exam II
Week 9：Centers of Lines, Areas, and Volumes
Week 10：Centroids and Moment of Inertia
Week 11：Mid-term exam III
Week 12：Distributed forces - Beams - External effects
Week 13：Distributed forces - Beams - Internal effects
Week 14：Cables and fluid statics
Week 15：Mid-term exam IV
Week 16：Friction
Week 17：Virtual work
Week 18：Final exam
scorePolicy:
Mid-term exam I 15%
Mid-term exam II 15%
Mid-term exam III 15%
Mid-term exam IV 15%
Final exam 15%
Assignments 25%
materials:
*1. J.L. Meriam, L.G. Kraige and J.N. Bolton, "Meriam's Engineering Mechanics: Statics," SI version, 9the edition, WILEY. ISBN:978-1119-66504-5
2. ENGINEERING MECHANICS: Statics 14/E (SI), HIBBELER, Pearson, USA, 2016
3. VECTOR MECHANICS FOR ENGINEERS：Statics 10/E (SI), BEER / JOHNSTON / CORNWELL, MCGRAW-HILL, USA, 2012
4. Self-made materials
